name: agy-imagegen
description: Generate images with Gemini (Antigravity or API key), OpenAI (API key), the free Pollinations service or a local model, and save them where you want. Works in Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images with Gemini, OpenAI or free models and save them where you want
interface.longDescription: Turns a text description into an image file. It drives Gemini (Antigravity CLI or API key), OpenAI (API key), the free Pollinations service or a local OpenAI-compatible model; Codex itself cannot generate images headlessly, so this gives Codex image generation through those backends. No permission bypass and no window automation: a wrapper script copies the result to your chosen path, converting between PNG, JPEG, BMP and GIF if needed. Windows + PowerShell.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a red fox in a snowy forest, watercolor style.
Make a flat vector logo for my coffee shop.
Draw a cozy cabin at night and save it to my Pictures folder.
